rule_title: TTP 1547.010 - Print Spooler Port Abuse - DLL Path Registered as Printer Port
description: Broader variant covering Add-PrinterPort with any suspicious Name value — relative paths (.\), UNC paths (\\), or explicit DLL extensions. Legitimate printer port names are always TCP/IP addresses, hostnames, or standard port identifiers like COM1, LPT1. A DLL path or relative path as the Name parameter is unambiguously malicious.
